---
chat_id: DEPARTMENT-00-ALL-TEAMS-ROOM
schema_version: 2
accepts_from: ["MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION"]
sends_to: []
route_edges: []
title: 00 모든 팀 상황실
purpose: 검증된 상태와 Release 및 차단 포인터 공지
role_context_ids: ["CONTEXT-STEWARD"]

authority_links: ["AGENTS.md","docs/작업큐.md","docs/team/DECISIONS.md","docs/team/handoffs/README.md","docs/team/roles/ORCHESTRATION.md","docs/team/teams/00-all-teams-room.md","docs/team/MODEL-ACCESS.md"]

---

---
chat_id: DEPARTMENT-01-PRODUCT-MOBILE
schema_version: 2

sends_to: ["MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT"]
route_edges: ["MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT|TASK_RESULT"]

---

---

---

sends_to: ["MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT"]
route_edges: ["MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT|TASK_RESULT"]

---

---

---

accepts_from: ["MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION","DEPARTMENT-01-PRODUCT-MOBILE","DEPARTMENT-02-DATA-BACKEND","DEPARTMENT-03-SERVER-OPERATIONS","DEPARTMENT-04-QUALITY-REVIEW","DEPARTMENT-05-KNOWLEDGE-ORCHESTRATION"]
sends_to: ["MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION","DEPARTMENT-01-PRODUCT-MOBILE","DEPARTMENT-02-DATA-BACKEND","DEPARTMENT-03-SERVER-OPERATIONS","DEPARTMENT-04-QUALITY-REVIEW","DEPARTMENT-05-KNOWLEDGE-ORCHESTRATION"]

role_context_ids: ["SOLAR-ORCH"]
input: ["normalized request","confirmed route pointer","HANDOFF pointer"]
output: ["Task execution pointer","status or HANDOFF pointer"]
authority_links: ["AGENTS.md","docs/작업큐.md","docs/team/DECISIONS.md","docs/team/handoffs/README.md","docs/team/roles/ORCHESTRATION.md","docs/team/teams/05-knowledge-orchestration.md","docs/team/MODEL-ACCESS.md"]

---
chat_id: MASTER-04-DEVELOPMENT-STAGING
schema_version: 2
accepts_from: ["MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION"]
sends_to: ["MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION","MASTER-01-HUMAN-DECISIONS"]

role_context_ids: ["SOLAR-OPS"]
input: ["approved candidate pointer","staging evidence pointer"]
output: ["development gate pointer","staging result pointer"]
authority_links: ["AGENTS.md","docs/작업큐.md","docs/team/DECISIONS.md","docs/team/handoffs/README.md","docs/team/roles/OPERATIONS.md","docs/team/teams/03-server-supabase-operations.md","docs/team/MODEL-ACCESS.md"]

---
chat_id: MASTER-05-PRODUCTION-RECOVERY
schema_version: 2
accepts_from: ["MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION"]
sends_to: ["MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION","MASTER-01-HUMAN-DECISIONS"]

title: 05 운영 배포 · 복구 게이트
purpose: 운영 Go No-Go와 복구 증거 연결
role_context_ids: ["SOLAR-OPS"]
input: ["human gate Decision pointer","release and recovery evidence pointer"]
output: ["production gate pointer","deployment or recovery result pointer"]
authority_links: ["AGENTS.md","docs/작업큐.md","docs/team/DECISIONS.md","docs/team/handoffs/README.md","docs/team/roles/OPERATIONS.md","docs/team/teams/03-server-supabase-operations.md","docs/team/MODEL-ACCESS.md"]
allowed_routes: ["OPERATIONS"]
stop_conditions: ["missing production approval","unrecoverable change"]

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import atexit
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path


SCRIPT = Path(__file__).parents[1] / "scripts" / "team_router.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("team_router", SCRIPT)
assert SPEC and SPEC.loader
router = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(router)

HASH_A = "a" * 64
HASH_B = "b" * 64
HASH_C = "c" * 64
ROUTING = {
    "MASTER-01-HUMAN-DECISIONS": {"MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION": ("REQUEST", "DECISION_POINTER")},
    "MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION": {
        "MASTER-01-HUMAN-DECISIONS": ("AGGREGATE_RESULT", "VERIFIED_STATUS", "DECISION_POINTER"),
        "MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT": ("CONFIRMED_ROUTE", "TASK_DISPATCH"),
        "MASTER-04-DEVELOPMENT-STAGING": ("STAGING_GATE_REQUEST",),
        "MASTER-05-PRODUCTION-RECOVERY": ("PRODUCTION_GATE_REQUEST",),
        "DEPARTMENT-00-ALL-TEAMS-ROOM": ("VERIFIED_STATUS",),
    },
    "MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT": {
        "MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION": ("TASK_RESULT", "REVIEW_RESULT", "AGGREGATE_RESULT", "VERIFIED_STATUS", "DECISION_POINTER"),
        "DEPARTMENT-01-PRODUCT-MOBILE": ("TASK_DISPATCH",),
        "DEPARTMENT-02-DATA-BACKEND": ("TASK_DISPATCH",),
        "DEPARTMENT-03-SERVER-OPERATIONS": ("TASK_DISPATCH",),
        "DEPARTMENT-04-QUALITY-REVIEW": ("REVIEW_REQUEST", "TASK_DISPATCH"),
        "DEPARTMENT-05-KNOWLEDGE-ORCHESTRATION": ("TASK_DISPATCH",),
    },
    "MASTER-04-DEVELOPMENT-STAGING": {
        "MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION": ("STAGING_GATE_RESULT", "DECISION_POINTER"),
        "MASTER-01-HUMAN-DECISIONS": ("DECISION_POINTER",),
    },
    "MASTER-05-PRODUCTION-RECOVERY": {
        "MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION": ("DECISION_POINTER", "VERIFIED_STATUS"),
        "MASTER-01-HUMAN-DECISIONS": ("DECISION_POINTER",),
    },
    "DEPARTMENT-00-ALL-TEAMS-ROOM": {},
    "DEPARTMENT-01-PRODUCT-MOBILE": {"MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT": ("TASK_RESULT",)},
    "DEPARTMENT-02-DATA-BACKEND": {"MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT": ("TASK_RESULT",)},
    "DEPARTMENT-03-SERVER-OPERATIONS": {"MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT": ("TASK_RESULT",)},
    "DEPARTMENT-04-QUALITY-REVIEW": {"MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT": ("REVIEW_RESULT", "TASK_RESULT")},
    "DEPARTMENT-05-KNOWLEDGE-ORCHESTRATION": {"MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT": ("TASK_RESULT",)},
}


def create_project_fixture() -> tuple[tempfile.TemporaryDirectory, Path, str]:
    holder = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    root = Path(holder.name)
    chat_dir = root / "docs" / "team" / "chats"
    chat_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    accepts = {chat_id: [] for chat_id in ROUTING}
    for source, targets in ROUTING.items():
        for target in targets:
            accepts[target].append(source)
    for index, (chat_id, targets) in enumerate(ROUTING.items()):
        edges = [f"{target}|{','.join(kinds)}" for target, kinds in targets.items()]
        body = "\n".join([
            "---", f"chat_id: {chat_id}", "schema_version: 2",
            f"accepts_from: {json.dumps(accepts[chat_id])}",
            f"sends_to: {json.dumps(list(targets))}", f"route_edges: {json.dumps(edges)}", "---", "",
        ])
        (chat_dir / f"chat-{index:02d}.md").write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
    plan = root / ".codex" / "mission-relay" / "model-plan.json"
    plan.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    plan.write_text('{"status":"SEALED"}\n', encoding="utf-8")
    plan_sha = hashlib.sha256(plan.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    plan.with_suffix(plan.suffix + ".sha256").write_text(f"{plan_sha}  model-plan.json\n", encoding="ascii")
    design = root / "docs" / "routing-design.md"
    design.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    design.write_text("# Routing design\n", encoding="utf-8")
    policy = {
        "schemaVersion": 1, "mode": "SIMULATION_ONLY", "implementationDecisionId": "DEC-IMPLEMENT-001",
        "decisionStatus": "ACTIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_ONLY", "activationDecisionId": None,
        "dispatchEnabled": False, "humanRelayEnabled": False, "retryLimit": 2,
        "expectedChatCount": 11, "designPath": "docs/routing-design.md",
        "designSha256": hashlib.sha256(design.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "allowedMessageKinds": sorted(router.MESSAGE_KINDS),
    }
    policy_path = root / ".codex" / "team-router" / "policy.json"
    policy_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    policy_path.write_text(json.dumps(policy), encoding="utf-8")
    return holder, root, plan_sha


FIXTURE_HOLDER, REPO, MODEL_PLAN_SHA = create_project_fixture()
atexit.register(FIXTURE_HOLDER.cleanup)


def assert_blocked(case: unittest.TestCase, code: str, callback, *args):
    with case.assertRaises(router.RouterError) as caught:
        callback(*args)
    case.assertEqual(code, caught.exception.code)


def event(sequence: int = 0, previous: str = router.ZERO_HASH, **overrides):
    value = {
        "entry_id": f"ENTRY-{sequence}",
        "route_id": "ROUTE-ONE",
        "sequence": sequence,
        "event_type": "ROUTE_STATE",
        "state": "RECEIVED",
        "actor_logical_chat_id": "MASTER-01-HUMAN-DECISIONS",
        "logical_target_chat_id": "MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION",
        "resolved_endpoint_ref": None,
        "resolved_endpoint_generation": None,
        "delivery_token": None,
        "attempt": 0,
        "payload_sha256": HASH_A,
        "created_at": "2026-09-04T00:00:00Z",
        "evidence_pointer": None,
        "previous_entry_sha256": previous,
    }
    value.update(overrides)
    return value


def receipt(chat_id: str = "MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT", expected_generation: int = 0, **overrides):
    value = {
        "logical_chat_id": chat_id,
        "mission_id": "MISSION-TEAM-ROUTER-001",
        "handoff_sha256": HASH_A,
        "expected_generation": expected_generation,
        "predecessor_endpoint_id": "provider-thread-before",
        "successor_endpoint_id": "provider-thread-after",
        "linked_successor_count": 1,
        "restore_verified": True,
        "restore_receipt_sha256": HASH_B,
        "study_gate_passed": True,
        "study_gate_receipt_sha256": HASH_C,
        "handoff_path": r"C:\MissionRelay\handoff.json",
        "successor_link_path": r"C:\MissionRelay\handoff.json.successor.json",
        "restore_receipt_path": r"C:\MissionRelay\handoff.json.restore.json",
        "study_gate_receipt_path": r"C:\MissionRelay\handoff.json.study-gate.json",
    }
    value.update(overrides)
    return value


def materialize_receipt(base: Path, value: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    result = dict(value or receipt())
    handoff = base / "handoff.json"
    successor = Path(str(handoff) + ".successor.json")
    restore = Path(str(handoff) + ".restore.json")
    study = Path(str(handoff) + ".study-gate.json")
    handoff.write_text(json.dumps({
        "status": "HANDOFF_SEALED", "sourceSessionId": result["predecessor_endpoint_id"],
        "mission": {"missionId": result["mission_id"]},
    }), encoding="utf-8")
    handoff_sha = hashlib.sha256(handoff.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    Path(str(handoff) + ".sha256").write_text(f"{handoff_sha}  handoff.json\n", encoding="ascii")
    successor.write_text(json.dumps({
        "status": "SUCCESSOR_CREATED", "handoffSha256": handoff_sha,
        "threadId": result["successor_endpoint_id"],
    }), encoding="utf-8")
    restore.write_text(json.dumps({"status": "RESTORE_VERIFIED", "sha256": handoff_sha}), encoding="utf-8")
    study.write_text(json.dumps({
        "status": "STUDY_GATE_PASSED", "handoffSha256": handoff_sha,
        "restoreReceiptPath": str(restore.resolve()), "qualifyingReviewRounds": 3,
        "qualifyingCrossReviewRounds": 2, "failures": [],
    }), encoding="utf-8")
    result.update({
        "handoff_sha256": handoff_sha,
        "restore_receipt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(restore.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "study_gate_receipt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(study.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "handoff_path": str(handoff.resolve()), "successor_link_path": str(successor.resolve()),
        "restore_receipt_path": str(restore.resolve()), "study_gate_receipt_path": str(study.resolve()),
    })
    return result


def active_policy():
    return {
        "dispatchEnabled": True,
        "decisionStatus": "ACTIVE_NON_PRODUCTION_DISPATCH",
    }


def activate_fixture(root: Path, model_plan_sha: str) -> dict:
    policy_path = root / ".codex" / "team-router" / "policy.json"
    policy = router.load_json(policy_path)
    policy.update({
        "mode": "ACTIVE_DISPATCH", "decisionStatus": "ACTIVE_NON_PRODUCTION_DISPATCH",
        "activationDecisionId": "DEC-ACTIVATE-001", "dispatchEnabled": True,
    })
    policy_path.write_text(json.dumps(policy), encoding="utf-8")
    decision = {
        "schemaVersion": 1, "decisionId": "DEC-ACTIVATE-001",
        "status": "ACTIVE_NON_PRODUCTION_DISPATCH",
        "approvalText": "실제 자동 라우팅 활성화를 승인합니다",
        "approvedAt": "2026-09-04T00:00:00+09:00", "projectId": "PROJECT-ONE",
        "scope": "NON_PRODUCTION_CHAT_MESSAGES", "humanRelayEnabled": False,
        "productionRoutesEnabled": False, "databaseMutationEnabled": False,
        "deploymentMutationEnabled": False, "designSha256": policy["designSha256"],
        "modelPlanSha256": model_plan_sha,
    }
    decision_path = root / router.ACTIVATION_DECISION
    decision_path.write_text(json.dumps(decision), encoding="utf-8")
    artifact_path = root / "docs" / "routing-design.md"
    artifact = {"path": "docs/routing-design.md", "sha256": router.sha256_file(artifact_path)}
    receipt = {
        "schemaVersion": 1, "status": "ACTIVATION_SEALED", "decisionId": "DEC-ACTIVATE-001",
        "decisionSha256": router.sha256_file(decision_path),
        "policySha256": router.sha256_file(policy_path), "designSha256": policy["designSha256"],
        "modelPlanSha256": model_plan_sha, "implementationArtifacts": [artifact],
        "reviewEvidence": [artifact],
    }

    def test_tamper_delete_and_reorder_are_detected(self):
        for mutation in ("tamper", "delete", "reorder"):
            with self.subTest(mutation=mutation), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
                root = Path(temp)
                first = router.append_event(root, "PROJECT-ONE", event())
                router.append_event(root, "PROJECT-ONE", event(1, first["entrySha256"], entry_id="ENTRY-ONE", state="PLANNED"))
                path = root / "PROJECT-ONE" / "routes" / "ROUTE-ONE.jsonl"
                lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
                if mutation == "tamper":
                    value = json.loads(lines[0])
                    value["state"] = "CONFIRMED"
                    lines[0] = json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":"))
                elif mutation == "delete":
                    lines = lines[1:]
                else:
                    lines.reverse()
                path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
                with self.assertRaises(router.RouterError):
                    router.verify_chain(path)

    def test_exported_tail_mismatch_is_detected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            router.append_event(root, "PROJECT-ONE", event())
            path = root / "PROJECT-ONE" / "routes" / "ROUTE-ONE.jsonl"
            assert_blocked(self, "TAIL_MISMATCH", router.verify_chain, path, HASH_C)


class DedupeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def record(self):
        return {
            "route_id": "ROUTE-ONE", "payload_sha256": HASH_A,
            "delivery_token": "DELIVERY-ONE", "logical_source_chat_id": "MASTER-03-DEPUTY-CONTEXT",
            "logical_target_chat_id": "DEPARTMENT-01-PRODUCT-MOBILE", "first_ack_sha256": HASH_B,
            "accepted_at": "2026-09-04T00:00:00Z",
        }

    def test_duplicate_returns_original_ack_without_reexecution(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            self.assertEqual("ACCEPTED", router.accept_dedupe(root, "PROJECT-ONE", self.record())["status"])
            duplicate = router.accept_dedupe(root, "PROJECT-ONE", self.record())
            self.assertEqual("DUPLICATE", duplicate["status"])
            self.assertEqual(HASH_B, duplicate["ackSha256"])

    def test_token_reuse_with_changed_identity_is_blocked(self):
        for field, value in (("payload_sha256", HASH_C), ("route_id", "ROUTE-TWO"),
                             ("logical_source_chat_id", "MASTER-02-ORCHESTRATION")):
            with self.subTest(field=field), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
                root = Path(temp)
                router.accept_dedupe(root, "PROJECT-ONE", self.record())
                changed = self.record()
                changed[field] = value
                assert_blocked(self, "DEDUPE_CONFLICT", router.accept_dedupe, root, "PROJECT-ONE", changed)


class SuccessorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_successor_requires_one_link_restore_and_study_gate(self):
        assert_blocked(self, "SUCCESSOR_COUNT", router.validate_successor_receipt,
                       receipt(linked_successor_count=2))
        assert_blocked(self, "SUCCESSOR_GATE", router.validate_successor_receipt,
                       receipt(restore_verified=False))
        assert_blocked(self, "SUCCESSOR_GATE", router.validate_successor_receipt,
                       receipt(study_gate_passed=False))

    def test_plan_exposes_only_hmac_endpoint_references(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            value = materialize_receipt(Path(temp), receipt())
            result = router.plan_successor(Path(temp), "PROJECT-ONE", value)
            rendered = json.dumps(result)
            self.assertNotIn(value["predecessor_endpoint_id"], rendered)
            self.assertNotIn(value["successor_endpoint_id"], rendered)
            self.assertTrue(result["predecessorEndpointRef"].startswith("ENDPOINT-HMAC-SHA256:"))
            self.assertFalse(result["messageSent"])

    def test_successor_evidence_bytes_and_status_are_verified(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            value = materialize_receipt(root, receipt())
            Path(value["study_gate_receipt_path"]).write_text(
                json.dumps({"status": "STUDY_GATE_BLOCKED", "handoffSha256": value["handoff_sha256"]}),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            assert_blocked(self, "SUCCESSOR_STUDY_MISMATCH", router.plan_successor,
                           root, "PROJECT-ONE", value)

    def test_implementation_only_policy_blocks_successor_activation(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            policy = router.load_policy(REPO)
            assert_blocked(self, "SUCCESSOR_ACTIVATION_DISABLED", router.apply_successor,
                           Path(temp), "PROJECT-ONE", policy, receipt())

    def test_generation_cas_and_mission_lineage(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            evidence_one = root / "evidence-one"
            evidence_one.mkdir()
            first = materialize_receipt(evidence_one, receipt())
            result = router.apply_successor(root, "PROJECT-ONE", active_policy(), first)
            self.assertEqual(1, result["generation"])
            assert_blocked(self, "DUPLICATE_HANDOFF_SUCCESSOR", router.apply_successor,
                           root, "PROJECT-ONE", active_policy(), first)
            evidence_two = root / "evidence-two"
            evidence_two.mkdir()
            second = materialize_receipt(evidence_two, receipt(
                expected_generation=1,
                predecessor_endpoint_id="provider-thread-after",
                successor_endpoint_id="provider-thread-final",
                mission_id="MISSION-DIFFERENT",
            ))
            assert_blocked(self, "MISSION_LINEAGE", router.apply_successor,
                           root, "PROJECT-ONE", active_policy(), second)

    def test_one_chat_rollover_does_not_modify_other_chat_mapping(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            other_dir = root / "other-evidence"
            other_dir.mkdir()
            other = materialize_receipt(other_dir, receipt(chat_id="DEPARTMENT-01-PRODUCT-MOBILE",
                            predecessor_endpoint_id="mobile-old", successor_endpoint_id="mobile-new"))
            router.apply_successor(root, "PROJECT-ONE", active_policy(), other)
            other_path = root / "PROJECT-ONE" / "endpoints" / "DEPARTMENT-01-PRODUCT-MOBILE.json"
            before = other_path.read_bytes()
            primary_dir = root / "primary-evidence"
            primary_dir.mkdir()
            router.apply_successor(root, "PROJECT-ONE", active_policy(), materialize_receipt(primary_dir, receipt()))
            self.assertEqual(before, other_path.read_bytes())

    def test_cli_has_no_send_command(self):
        self.assertNotIn("send", router.build_parser()._subparsers._group_actions[0].choices)
